name: Uzair Khan
intro: an artificial intelligence researcher and deep learning engineer passionate about bridging the gap between theoretical machine learning and practical industrial impact. Completing my industrial Ph.D. at the University of Verona, I specialize in vision foundation models, time-series anomaly detection, and edge AI. My work centers on making industrial operations smarter and more dependable—deploying lightweight algorithms for predictive maintenance and zero-shot visual inspection that reduce machinery downtime, cut latency, and perform reliably in production environments.
